scope: Single-source receiver m1-natural, full three-view PAMF and reference response; seeds 2026092701/02/03. Target test results for this setting are already exposed and this is development evaluation.
hypothesis: The multiple paths are actually used through their deployed joint160 fusion. For the same source-U packet, an existing source-channel As view that passes four-of-five L-anchored branch votes can supervise the fused representation to remain close to that packet's detached raw-view fusion. This uses same-packet identity rather than assuming independently sampled same-pseudo-label signals are the same real device. This is a testable modeling hypothesis, not proof that simulated channel alterations always preserve TX information or a claim that physics consistency is new.
method: Keep the prior day_physics Tri continuation and its masks, cross-day branch relations, branch-specific U/L guard and source-channel As selection. Capture actual joint160 from the first two existing ordinary U student passes and the corresponding two existing mixed-view U passes; no extra student forward. For selected physical slots only, apply mean 1-cosine between detached ordinary and physical fusion features, averaged across all U slots. Scale with the existing Tri U joint-contrast coefficient 0.05, U weight 6 and CE normalizer 1.25; no new hyperparameter. Add to the existing protected U objective. Same packet selection must be a subset of originally accepted source U and existing certified source As. Signal As strength and taper remain the old registered rule. All raw pseudo-CE masks, unlabeled data roles and deployed graph remain unchanged.
initialization: Exact same-setting and same-seed source-only original Tri E20, followed by own E10+E20 to fixed E50/11100. Check complete ancestry and sample contracts.
evaluation: Freeze all three candidate predictions before independent truth-last scoring of clean and six practical scenes. DURA-LU primary, DURA-L/raw secondary; report cross_date separately from cross_rx/cross_both, all seeds, physical-ID paired corrections and regressions, TX/RX/day. No leo_weak or target-guided checkpoint selection/reruns.
success: Greater than 2 percentage points over ordinary PL in clean and every practical DURA-LU scene, and improvement over Tri; report every individual seed and adverse scene. Extra settings and independent evidence are needed before any universal claim.
command: python -m experiments.pamf_physics_tri.publish --fused-physics --repo REPO --output UNIQUE_LOCAL_ROOT --context EXISTING_CONTEXT --ssh-config N607_CONFIG
resources: N607 ordinary account, GPU 0–7, up to four observed or pending processes per GPU including other owners subject to memory reservation; preserve other healthy processes.
stop_rule: Any systemic technical failure stops new dispatch and preserves healthy workers and artifacts. Actual E20 no-query smoke must show nonzero selected samples and real signature/reference gradients.
expected_artifacts: Three real-E20 no-query source smoke checks with fusion gradients
Three own E30/E50 models and source-channel fusion counters
Three frozen seven-scene prediction sets and independent matching scores
